The '''Five Masters''' was the name given to the leadership of the [[Wookiee Liberation Front]] and led by the [[Master in White]]. Each of the Five Masters was skilled in one or more forms of martial arts, among them [[Wrruushi/Legends|Wrruushi]] and the [[K'thri]] Arts, which allowed them to move about unarmed, even in locations where their presence was not welcome. All but the [[Master in Violet]] were killed when an [[Fiend of shadow|unknown force]] [[Destruction of the Five Masters Academy|ripped through]] the facility and burned it to the ground.
